verdict.rationale: Klaviyo offers AI features like an AI-powered subject line generator, a Composer tool that builds audiences/content from a stated goal, and a Customer Agent that surfaces order info, showing some in-product AI-generated suggestions. However, evidence doesn't show broader proactive 'insights' about performance/data trends generated by AI within the product dashboard itself. missing for 10: dedicated AI insights/analytics dashboard evidence, independent hands-on verification of these AI features' quality.
